lines.en: Oh, my baby, are you all right?
Hey, don't get any blood on my floor!
Do you know how hard it is to find an original choke knob for a 19--
Mommy, you got married my cookie.
I'll tell you who it is.
Yeah, I stole all the TV remotes.
Robert, why would you steal TV remotes?
Because I love the way they feel against my skin in the moonlight.
Just take me to jail! Away from her!
How long will he be in jail?
